    for i in range(n):

        partition[i] = 1 - partition[i]
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            current_cut = new_cut
            improved = True
            break
        else:
            # Revert the flip
            partition[i] = 1 - partition[i]

# Try multiple random restarts to escape local optima
